title: Policy Quality Feedback Wiring
objective: Wire existing SprintPolicyManager.update_with_quality_decisions() into scheduler teardown without new RL framework

additions: 4 telemetry fields on SprintSchedulerResult: policy_quality_feedback_calls, policy_quality_feedback_decisions, policy_quality_feedback_sources, policy_quality_feedback_errors
runtime/sprint_scheduler.py.teardown_wiring: After _adapt_source_weights_from_feedback(), reconstruct FindingQualityDecision-style dicts from _source_quality_feedback, call policy_manager.update_with_quality_decisions() when enabled and decisions exist. Fail-soft with CancelledError propagation.

rl/sprint_policy_manager.py.inject_scheduler_fix: Returns early when disabled to prevent scheduler reference leakage into disabled policy manager

fail_soft_invariants: CancelledError propagates through policy feedback call
all other exceptions caught and logged at DEBUG level
empty decisions list handled without error
malformed decisions (missing fields, wrong types) handled without crash
disabled policy manager has zero side effects
bounded_invariants: 200 source_types max in update_with_quality_decisions (existing bound preserved)
